patterns: am i talking to a robot
responses: I'm Brewie, an automated assistant for BrewBox. I can answer questions about plans, prices, delivery, orders, payments and brewing tips. For anything else I'll point you to our support team.
BrewBox delivers freshly roasted coffee beans to your door. We roast in small batches every week and ship within 48 hours of roasting.

We have three plans:
• Starter: 250 g every 2 weeks, $12/month
• Regular: 500 g every 2 weeks, $22/month
• Family: 1 kg every 2 weeks, $39/month
You can pause or switch any time.

patterns: how much for a bag of beans
responses: Plans start at $12/month for the Starter plan. One-off bags are $9 for 250 g. Shipping is free on all subscriptions.

patterns: when will i receive my order
how many days until it arrives
responses: Orders ship within 48 hours of roasting. Delivery takes 2 to 4 business days in most areas and 5 to 8 business days internationally.

patterns: which countries do you deliver to
responses: We ship to 35 countries, including the US, UK, UAE, Pakistan and most of the EU. Enter your address at checkout to see if your area is covered.

patterns: how can i track my package
responses: You can track your order from the confirmation email, or under Account > Orders using your tracking number. If it has been more than 8 business days, contact support and we'll look into it.

patterns: how do i get a refund
responses: If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, message us within 7 days with a photo and we'll send a replacement or refund you in full. Opened bags that you simply didn't enjoy can be swapped once for a different roast.

patterns: what payment methods do you accept
can i pay with credit card
responses: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal and Apple Pay. Cash on delivery is available in selected cities in Pakistan.

patterns: how do i cancel my subscription
responses: You can cancel, pause or skip a delivery under Account > Subscription. There are no fees, and changes made 3 days before your next shipment apply to that shipment.

patterns: how do i get a discount
responses: New customers get 15% off their first month with code WELCOME15. Students get 10% off with a valid student email.

patterns: i need to talk to a human

responses: Our support team is at support@brewbox.example, Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm. Live chat on this page is also staffed during those hours.

patterns: what grind size should i use
how to make espresso at home
responses: A good starting point: 60 g of coffee per litre of water, water at 92 to 96 °C. Use a coarse grind for French press, medium for filter and fine for espresso.

patterns: what is the difference between light and dark roast
responses: We offer light, medium and dark roasts, all single-origin Arabica, plus a Swiss-water decaf. Light is brighter and fruitier, dark is bolder and more bitter. If you're unsure, start with our medium roast.
